evals.name: extract-slices-and-create-issues
evals.prompt: Break the provider-abstraction PRD into Linear issues.
evals.expected_output: LLM extracts slices from the PRD body, presents them for operator review, then creates flat Linear Issues under the provider-abstraction Project with blocked-by relations, labels (bundle:*, tracer, slice:hitl|slice:afk, from:prd-provider-abstraction), and issue bodies following the template.

evals.name: refuses-when-no-prd
evals.prompt: Break the nonexistent-slug PRD into issues.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses with a clear error pointing the operator to /risoluto-to-prd first.

evals.name: refuses-when-issues-exist
evals.prompt: Break the provider-abstraction PRD into issues (issues already exist with from:prd-provider-abstraction label).
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses, reporting that issues already exist for this PRD. No duplicate issues created.
